name: Generation Chart (Laws of the Night Revised)

text.content:
The Generation chart from Laws of the Night Revised (Character Creation & Traits, p. 95). On this system, setting a character's Generation on their sheet automatically applies their starting Willpower and Blood Pool, and caps their maximum permanent Willpower.

Max Traits is the ceiling for total Traits in your primary Attribute category; Max Abilities is the highest level allowed in any one Ability. 14th and 15th generation (thin-blood) are not on the book chart and use the 13th-generation row.
